# THE CHAIRMAN'S TWO CONDITIONS (15:5x CST): no step leaves Icon slower on origin (so the leaves learn the tag, step 2, before lists become blocks, step 4), and the switch carries the tree on the rt_lv view (step 3 routes the last direct reaches through it, step 4 changes its body, 5a to 5f take the users off it a few files a landing and 5f deletes it). THE SPEED GATE of the plan: kernel A not above the baseline commit, kernel B below it, each counted by the caller's own seat in the same sitting within one part in a million (the chairman's ruling of 16:1x CST: the baseline is a commit, never a number another seat read; an exact bound against a stored number reads red on nothing).
